metadata.subject: Physics
metadata.topic: Gas Laws — Combined Gas Law: Final Volume of Heated Gas
metadata.note: Fixed mass of gas in a cylinder heated from 27°C to 627°C while pressure drops from 1.0×10⁵ Pa to 1.8×10⁴ Pa. Classic combined gas law application. Q4b(i) is kinetic theory explanation — open/deferred.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q4b(ii) — Combined Gas Law: Final Volume
question.text:
A fixed mass of gas is trapped in a cylinder by a movable piston. An electrical heater raises the temperature from initial to final conditions:

  • Initial: P₁ = 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa, V₁ = 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ m³, T₁ = 27°C
  • Final: P₂ = 1.8 × 10⁴ Pa, T₂ = 627°C

Calculate the final volume V₂ of the gas. (6 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Model solution:
Step 1: T₁ = 27 + 273 = 300 K
Step 2: T₂ = 627 + 273 = 900 K
Step 3: Apply P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂
V₂ = (P₁ × V₁ × T₂) / (P₂ × T₁) = (1.0×10⁵ × 1.9×10⁻⁴ × 900) / (1.8×10⁴ × 300)
= 17 100 / 5 400 000 = 3.17 × 10⁻³ m³

Sense check: Temperature tripled (300→900 K) and pressure dropped to 18% of initial — volume should increase significantly. V₂ ≈ 16.7 × V₁ ✓

steps.label:
Given: P₁ = 1.0×10⁵ Pa  |  V₁ = 1.9×10⁻⁴ m³  |  T₁ = 27°C  |  P₂ = 1.8×10⁴ Pa  |  T₂ = 627°C
Formula: P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂ (temperatures MUST be in Kelvin)
Convert: T(K) = θ(°C) + 273
Convert both temperatures to Kelvin. (2 marks)
Apply the combined gas law to find V₂. (4 marks)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Convert °C to K: add 273. T₁ = 27 + 273 = 300 K.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Rearrange P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂ to get V₂ = (P₁ × V₁ × T₂) / (P₂ × T₁).

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: V₂ = (P₁ × V₁ × T₂) / (P₂ × T₁). Make sure T is in Kelvin (not Celsius).
